prompt: Create square Spotify playlist cover art for FUNK GUERRA!, styled as a bold vintage screen-printed pirate funk album poster. Use a black background with a restricted palette of warm cream and vivid red-orange, heavy distressed ink texture, rough halftone/grunge speckles, sharp high-contrast vector shapes, and dramatic comic-book lighting. The central subject is one fierce pirate captain in side profile facing right, with long braided black hair, a full beard, hoop earring, tricorn hat with a skull-and-crossbones emblem, and a dark naval coat with cream outlines and buttons. He grips a large ship wheel in the lower right foreground. Behind him, include exactly 2 pirate symbols: one skull-and-crossbones on his hat and one skull-and-crossbones on a black flag to the right. Add one huge red-orange distressed moon filling the upper left corner behind the pirate. In the upper right, place a small rectangular red-orange outline label containing 1 HOUR in bold uppercase block letters. The bottom half is dominated by oversized stacked typography: the first word FUNK in cream, and the second word GUERRA! in red-orange, both in massive condensed sans-serif slab/block lettering with tight spacing. Composition should feel like aggressive punk-funk pirate propaganda cover art, clean enough to read at thumbnail size, with no extra text, no watermark, no realistic photo rendering, and no additional characters.

promptZh: 为 FUNK GUERRA! 创建正方形 Spotify 播放列表封面艺术，风格设定为大胆的复古丝网印刷海盗放克专辑海报。使用黑色背景，搭配暖奶油色和鲜艳红橙色的受限色调，呈现厚重的做旧墨迹质感、粗糙的半调/颗粒感、锐利的高对比度矢量形状以及戏剧性的漫画书式光影。中心主体是一位侧脸向右的凶猛海盗船长，留着长长的黑色辫子和浓密胡须，佩戴圆环耳环，头戴印有骷髅交叉骨标志的三角帽，身穿带有奶油色轮廓和纽扣的深色海军大衣。他在右下角前景处紧握一个巨大的船舵。在他身后，包含 2 个海盗符号：一个位于帽子上，另一个位于右侧的黑色旗帜上。在左上角海盗身后添加一个巨大的红橙色做旧月亮。在右上角放置一个小的长方形红橙色轮廓标签，内含以粗体大写字母书写的 1 HOUR。下半部分由超大的堆叠排版占据：第一个单词 FUNK 为奶油色，第二个单词 GUERRA! 为红橙色，两者均采用巨大的压缩无衬线板式/块状字体，字间距紧凑。整体构图应呈现出具有侵略性的朋克放克海盗宣传画风格，确保在缩略图尺寸下清晰易读，且不包含额外文本、水印、写实照片渲染或额外角色。
